reason: I already carry a bottle I like every day, and the tap water at home is fine. The only time I'd want a filter is a few hotel trips a year, and that doesn't justify $68 up front plus a filter subscription.
objection: I'd be paying for another bottle and an ongoing filter plan to fix a problem I have maybe a handful of days a year, and a new bottle plus plastic filter cartridges every two months doesn't feel that eco to me.
would_change_my_mind: A filter that fits into the bottle I already own, or a travel-only option without a subscription, like a bottle plus a couple of filters I buy once with no plan.
